$comment: PSI's inputs to the platform permissions generator (authz/tools/gen/estate.py says what each key means). PSI runs no business application yet: the platform's own manifest is the only one, and an application added under apps/<app>/authz.manifest.json joins by the second glob. Generated artefacts live under estate/authz/. Run from a SEB checkout: python3 authz/tools/generate.py --estate <psi>/estate/authz.json
